project.name: Itineris: Distributed Graph Database
project.description: Itineris is a distributed graph database optimized for processing massive-scale graphs represented over a machine cluster. Itineris separates the concerns of graph processing and manipulation from storing the graph on disk, delegating that concern to an extensible set of persistence solutions.
